Commentary.Commentary: .. The Run Chase ...
We are set for the chase te begin! Australia Women's openers, Beth Mooney and Alyssa Healy are at the crease! Jhulan Goswami to start with the ball. Here we go..

Right then. 275 runs is the target for Australia Women. It is a tough ask but expect Australia Women to come all guns blazing. Will they chase it down? We will find out. Stay tuned as the chase comes our way in a short while.

Australian bowlers did not have the best day with the ball in hand and they would be a touch disappointed. They did manage to break the opening partnership of Verma and Mandhana, courtesy of some good bowling from Sophie Molineux. She, along with Tahlia McGrath was the pick of the bowlers for Australia as they took two and three wickets respectively. The other bowlers did give away some freebies to India's batters and they did not fail to cash in on those. Overall, they would feel that they could have done much better in the field, especially having won the toss but as we saw it is a good pitch to bat on and we cannot rule out Australia just yet.

Having put into bat, India Women started really well, courtesy of some good positive batting from their openers, Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma. They put on an opening stand of 74 runs before Verma got out. Mithali Raj came in at number 3 but a mix-up in the middle with Smriti Mandhana saw the Indian captain walking back. After that it was Mandhana and Richa Ghosh who carried on in their merry way and both of them scored at a brisk rate. Once Mandhana got out, it was now for their lower order and they delivered. Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar and Jhulan Goswami scored crucial runs for their side and helped them to put up a very good total on the board.

This has been a brilliant comeback from India Women after having lost their first game and they would feel that they have got enough runs on the board to break Australia Women's winning streak. The Aussies will still feel that they will be able to chase it down as they bat pretty deep and not to forget that their batters are in top form.

That ends Powerplay 1. India Women are in a good situation with 68 for 0!
Floated, around middle and leg. Mandhana flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one. India Women are 68-0 at the end of Powerplay 1.
Flighted ball, around off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to mid off.
Tossed up, outside off. Smriti Mandhana prods forward and drives it to cover. The fielder there fumbles and concedes two runs.
Floated, around off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to mid off.
Quicker ball, just outside off. Smriti Mandhana works it to mid on once again.
Flatter ball, on off. Smriti Mandhana turns it to mid on.
Change. Sophie Molineux comes in the attack now.
FOUR! Nicely done! Gardner sprays one down leg. Shafali Verma gets low and sweeps it uppishly over the square leg fielder for a boundary.
A tad short, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Flatter and quicker, on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Tossed up, down leg. Smriti Mandhana gets low and sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Tossed up, on off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out.
Leg bye! Flatter ball, down leg. Shafali Verma misses the flick and the ball tickles her thigh pad before going towards fine leg. The batters take a leg bye!
A slight halt in play. Verma has some issue with her left thigh it seems. The physio uses the magic spray and we are good to go. Also, Ashleigh Gardner comes in the attack now.
Short of a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and cuts it yet again through covers for a couple of runs this time.
Wide! Too wide, outside off. Smriti Mandhana lets it be. Wide called.

FOUR! Third boundary of the over and Smriti Mandhana is on a roll! Short of a length, outside off. Mandhana rocks back and cuts it uppishly through cover-point for a boundary. The fielder there dives but she had no chance of catching that ball.
Length ball, outside off. Mandhana leaves it alone.
FOUR! AND AGAIN! Similar delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana punches it off the back foot through covers for another boundary.
FOUR! Punished by Smriti Mandhana. Back of a length, just outside off. Mandhana stays back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Short of a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana looks to cut, but it goes off the inside edge to Alyssa Healy behind the sticks. She dives to her right to stop the ball.
Length ball, on off. Shafali Verma pushes it to cover.
In the air...just over the point fielder. Short ball, outside off. Mandhana stays back and cuts it. The fielder at point leaps to her right but the ball goes past her. A single taken.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, angling away, just outside off. Smriti Mandhana looks to drive on the up but she misses yet again.
Length ball, strayed on the pads. Mandhana clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Well bowled! Length ball, moving away after pitching, outside off. Smriti Mandhana looks to play a cover drive but the ball zips past her outside edge.
Good-length ball, on middle. Smriti Mandhana tucks it on the leg side.
Play and a miss! Good-length ball, outside off. Shafali Verma hangs back to pull but fails to get any bat on it.
Length ball, outside off, shaping away late. Shafali Verma leaves it alone.
FOUR! WHACKED! Short ball, on off. Shafali Verma stays back and hoicks it towards deep mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence.
Brown bangs in short yet again, around leg. Shafali Verma ducks under it.
Brown bangs in short, around off. Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it towards fine leg to collect a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and cuts it to point.
Shorter again, around leg. This time, Smriti Mandhana pulls it nicely towards deep square leg for one.
Back of a length, on leg. Smriti Mandhana looks to pull but gets hit on the body.
Perry errs in line and bowls one down the leg side. Mandhana misses the flick. This is called a wide.
Length ball, on off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out.
Full toss, on the pads. Verma clips it to deep square leg for a single.
The physio is out as per the concussion protocol as Shafali Verma has been hit on the helmet. She looks fine and we are good to go.

FOUR LEG BYES! That stayed a touch low! Perry digs it short, on leg. But the ball does not rise much. Verma takes her eyes off the ball. The ball hits her helmet and goes between the keeper and first slip. It runs to the third man fence.
Full ball, way outside off. Verma goes for the drive but gets it from the toe end of the bat. The ball goes over covers and the batters get a couple.
Short ball, on leg. Mandhana ducks under this one.
Length ball, outside off. Pushed to the off side again.
Back of a length, outside off. Mandhana defends it towards covers.
On a length, on off. Verma pushes it past point for a single now.
Short ball, around off. Verma taps it towards point.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Punished by Mandhana! Perry errs in length and bowls a very full one, outside off. Mandhana drives it through covers for another boundary.
Full again, on off. Pushed back to the bowler.

Fuller ball, lands on off and nips away a touch. Verma looks to drive but gets the outside edge. The ball rolls to the left of point. The fielder dives but cannot stop the ball. The batters cross over.
Another length ball, around off. Verma clips it towards mid-wicket.
On a length, on off. Verma works it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Pumped by Verma! Fuller ball, outside off and swinging away. Verma cracks it past covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Mandhana! Brown bowls a full one, on the pads. Mandhana works it to the fine leg fence for the second boundary of the over.
Short of a length again, outside off. Mandhana punches it towards cover.
Fuller ball, on off. Punched to covers.
FOUR! Punished by Smriti Mandhana! Shorter ball, outside off. She cuts it hard past point for a boundary.
On a length, around leg. Mandhana works it to the leg side again.
Back of a length, around leg. Tucked towards mid-wicket.
Darcie Brown to bowl from the other end and to use the other ball.
Beaten! This is fuller, outside off. Verma is glued to the crease while looking to defend it. The ball shapes away a touch and goes past the outside edge.
On a length, around off. Verma opens the face of the bat and plays it. The fielder at gully dives to stop the ball.
Perry goes fuller now, around off. The ball lands and shapes away a touch. Verma pushes it towards point.
Shorter again, on the body. Mandhana has no problems in pulling it towards deep backward square leg for one.
Another couple! Back of a length, around off. Smriti Mandhana punches it past covers for a couple.
Perry starts with a shorter ball, around off. Mandhana pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder. The fielder chases it and the batters get two. India Women are underway!
We are set for the game to begin! India Women's openers, Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are at the crease! Ellyse Perry to start with the ball for the Aussies. Here we go...

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Yastika Bhatia, Mithali Raj (C), Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (WK), Pooja Vastrakar, Jhulan Goswami, Meghna Singh, Rajeshwari Gayakwad (In for Sneh Rana), Poonam Yadav.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Beth Mooney, Alyssa Healy (WK), Meg Lanning (C), Ellyse Perry, Ashleigh Gardner, Tahlia McGrath, Nicola Carey (In for Rachael Haynes), Sophie Molineux, Georgia Wareham, Hannah Darlington, Darcie Brown.
TOSS - Australia Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

After the first ODI, Mithali Raj asked for a better show from openers Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma. The opening pair could only put on 31 runs in the first ODI and did not have a great outing. But both Mandhana and Verma had a good run during their recent tour of England and would be desperate to perform better at the top. If India Women do get off to a good start then it would be interesting to see how the Aussies deal with it, because a player like Verma can take the game away from the opposition in a few overs.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd ODI of the three-match series between India Women and Australia Women. The first ODI between these two sides saw Australia Women handing the visitors a thumping defeat and they have now extended their tally to 25 consecutive wins in ODIs. India Women, on the other hand, would be eager to make comeback in this encounter as it is a must-win game for them now. Things are not looking good for the visitors as their vice-captain, Harmanpreet Kaur, has been ruled out of the 2nd ODI as well. The onus will be on their senior players like Mithali Raj, Smriti Mandhana, Deepti Sharma and Jhulan Goswami if they are to level the series 1-1 and in the process also break Australia's winning streak. Will they come out victorious against the mighty Aussies this time around? We will find that soon as this one promises to be an exciting contest. Stay tuned for toss and team news.
